subject: Asunite vendor activation — bank attestation and PO label mapping
messages:
From: Lila Mathews <lila.mathews@asunite.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@asunite.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor setup — Asunite banking proof and remittance format

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this — we're ready to get Asunite set up in your vendor system. Finance asked me to send the following so you can complete ACH enrollment and remittance mapping:

- Signed W-9 (attached)
- Bank attestation letter from our bank confirming account/ABA (attached)
- Completed ACH enrollment form (attached)

We currently use the following remittance format: one-line memo per invoice with PO number prefixed by "PO-" and a structured reference field (example: PO-123456 | INV-7890). If Redwood requires a different PO label or a structured key, please confirm so we can adjust.

A couple of notes:
- We'll need ACH to be enabled before Dec 8 to meet the first sprint payment.
- If micro-deposits are used for verification, please send the amounts (or instructions) so our AP can confirm.

Attaching: Asunite_W9.pdf, Asunite_Bank_Attestation_2027-11-28.pdf, Asunite_ACH_Form_Filled.pdf

Thanks —
Lila Mathews
Head of Finance Operations
Asunite Inc

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — Asunite banking proof and remittance format

Hi Lila —

Got everything, thank you. Quick summary of next steps from our side:

1) Finance (Marissa + Priyom) will initiate ACH enrollment in the vendor portal and submit the bank attestation to banking for verification.
2) We use micro-deposits for new vendor verifications. Bank will push two small credits (will appear as XXXX) within 1-2 business days; please confirm amounts once you see them.
3) Remittance/PO mapping: Redwood prefers a short prefix to map PO -> invoice in our AP system. Our recommended label is "ASN-<PO>" (e.g., ASN-123456). If you can include PO in the memo exactly as ASN-123456 we will auto-link the invoice to the PO. If changing that is difficult on your side, we can accept your current format but will need AP to relay the structured key in a separate reference field.

Marissa / Priyom: can you start the portal enrollment and flag any missing fields? I'll open the vendor ticket with Treasury.

Lila, I'm attaching a quick checklist we use (link sent separately) and I'll share the portal sign-on when the vendor record is created. Expect the micro-deposit push by EOD tomorrow (Mon, 11/29) if no exceptions.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0134

Subject: RE: New vendor setup — Asunite banking proof and remittance format

Hi Lila / Hannah —

We created the vendor record in the portal this morning (Vendor ID: V-785311). A few operational notes:

- Portal link: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/vendors/V-785311 (I'll send a secure invite to your AP mailbox).
- Micro-deposit amounts will be sent from our bank under descriptor "RW-INF-VER". Expect two deposits, typically under $0.50 each. Once you confirm the amounts we will flip the ACH status to "Enabled".
- We set the default remittance mapping to accept your current memo, but to auto-match we need the PO label to be "ASN-<PO>". If you cannot change the memo, please add the ASN label in the remittance reference field in the invoice submission or in the portal's "invoice reference" box.

Action items for Asunite AP:
- Confirm you received micro-deposits and reply with amounts (example reply: "received $0.11 and $0.32").
- Complete the portal access set-up (invite will be sent to ap@asunite.com).

Attaching: vendor-portal-invite-stub.txt (attachment).

Thanks —
